steps.name: Given "company1" is provisioned as a disposable COMPANY target
And "company1" stores their current token as "company_active_token"
And "influencer1" is provisioned as a disposable INFLUENCER target
And "influencer1" stores their current token as "influencer_active_token"
And "admin1" is signed in as the administrator
Then soft assert "company1" using stored token "company_active_token" calling "/users/me" returns 401

"company1" stored token "company_active_token" GET /users/me — BE source expects 401, mock-session collapse accepts {401,419}; got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T20:38:41.854","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/users/me","requestId":"REQ-1c968e92"}
When "company1" attempts to refresh their session token
Then soft assert "company1" refresh fails with "error.auth.account_disabled"

"company1" refresh should be rejected (error.auth.account_disabled); got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T20:38:41.877","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/auth/refresh-session","requestId":"REQ-ca60157c"}

session re-establishment for "company1" should succeed (HTTP 200; body: {"id":2505,"firebaseUserId":"E2ECOMPANY1789072721592","userType":{"value":"COMPANY","label":"Firma","originalLabel":"COMPANY"},"email":"bdd-aum-company1-company-1789072721582-fqshhz@e2e.test","profile)
And soft assert "company1" can access "/users/me" with status 200
And "company1" stores their current token as "company_reactivated_token"
Then soft assert "company1" using stored token "company_active_token" calling "/users/me" returns 419

Please wait...","path":"/api/users/me","requestId":"REQ-4e4eedbf"}

"influencer1" stored token "influencer_active_token" GET /users/me — BE source expects 401, mock-session collapse accepts {401,419}; got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T20:38:42.200","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/users/me","requestId":"REQ-71590037"}
When "influencer1" attempts to refresh their session token
Then soft assert "influencer1" refresh fails with "error.auth.account_disabled"

"influencer1" refresh should be rejected (error.auth.account_disabled); got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T20:38:42.211","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/auth/refresh-session","requestId":"REQ-18596903"}
